extracted.name: Hungarian Cucumber Salad
extracted.description: Cucumber, onion, and dill get a quick dressing in vinegar and oil for a simple, Hungarian-inspired cucumber salad.
ingredient_lines: 2 large seedless English cucumbers, sliced thin
0.5 teaspoon ground black pepper, or to taste
instruction_lines: Lightly toss cucumber slices, onion slices, and chopped dill together in a large bowl.
Pour vinegar over cucumber mixture; toss to coat.
Pour oil over cucumber mixture; toss to coat.
Season with salt and black pepper.
